summary: Slot 4 (the tree only: no PPO, no rollouts, no reward; the network learns its policy and value only from MCTS trees grown on its own greedy line; every simulator tick counted). Eleven recipes from scratch, all FAILED the first wall (8% by 2.0B total ticks; run 5 cleared it at 0.76B): best eval 2.675. Every eval dies in the first drop under the spawn platform. The trees find the way through every round (landings at 1.8%, lines to 5.9%), and the network learns their lines at the lines' own states, but cannot fly them from the start: label fixes (consistency along the greedy line, the spawn jitter, narrower random children, denser labels, a bigger replay buffer) raised the share of greedy flights reaching the landing ramp from 7% to 52%, and none of ~2,400 flights stayed on it. Bench: one round of tree-label distillation took run 5's skilled 4.90B policy from 84% to 8%. Reading for the user's question: the search alone finds the moves; a learner trained only on its labels does not become a controller - PPO (optimising the policy's own execution) is what the hybrid needs the second thread for; the tree's role is WHERE (spawns, curricula) and, beside PPO, what to prefer. Box released 08:30 UTC so the progressing slots keep their credit to the round end.
